en.title: Match Score Input
en.excerpt: Learn how organizers and field scorekeepers record end-by-end arrow values, track live set points, manage byes or forfeits, and auto-advance match winners.
en.content:
Once elimination brackets are generated, individual and team matches can be scored either directly by the tournament committee via the Organizer Dashboard or on the shooting line using the Archeris Mobile Scorekeeper app.

1. Accessing Elimination Matches

To view all scheduled matches across bracket rounds:

  1. Go to Organizer Dashboard > Elimination > Matches.
  2. Filter by category (e.g. Recurve Men U-15, Compound Women Open) and tournament stage (e.g. 1/8 Finals, Quarterfinals, Gold Final).
  3. Click on any match card or tree node to open the dedicated Match Scoring Modal.

2. Scoring from Organizer Dashboard

On the desktop scoring interface:

  • Set System (Recurve/Barebow): Enter arrow values (10, 9, 8, M, etc.) for Set 1. The system sums the end score (e.g., 28 vs 26) and automatically allocates Set Points (2 - 0). Continue to Set 2, 3, and beyond until one archer accumulates 6 set points.
  • Cumulative System (Compound): Enter 3 arrow values per end. The running total updates in real time until all 5 ends (15 arrows) are complete.
  • Click Save & Confirm Result to finalize the match.

3. Scoring via Mobile Scorekeeper

Field scorekeepers assigned to specific elimination target butts can record scores live on their mobile devices:

  1. Log in to the scorekeeper portal using the assigned session access code.
  2. Select the target butt number (e.g. Target 12 - Recurve Men Quarterfinal).
  3. Tap the virtual digital dial keypad to enter arrow scores for Archer A and Archer B.
  4. Confirm the end scores with both athletes.
  5. Upon completing the final set or shoot-off, submit the score. Results broadcast instantly to public live scores and bracket displays.

4. Managing Byes and Forfeits (WO)

Archeris provides automated handling for non-contested matches:

  • Automatic Bye: Matches involving a Bye seed are pre-resolved by the system. The seeded archer automatically advances without score input required.
  • Walkover / Forfeit (WO): If an athlete does not show up to the shooting line within the regulation call time, organizers can select Mark as Walkover (WO) on the match card. The attending archer is declared the winner with a 6-0 (Set) or default win.
  • Disqualification (DQ): If an archer violates equipment or safety rules, selecting Disqualify (DQ) awards victory to the opponent.

5. Automatic Bracket Tree Advancement

As soon as a match is finalized:

  • The winner is instantly placed into their designated slot in the next round of the bracket (e.g. advancing from 1/8 to Quarterfinals).
  • If the match is a Semifinal, the winner advances to the Gold Medal Match, while the runner-up is automatically slotted into the Bronze Medal Match.
  • Target butt and line assignments for subsequent rounds can be updated flexibly from the match scheduling panel.

id.title: Input Skor Pertandingan
id.excerpt: Panduan bagi panitia dan scorekeeper lapangan untuk mencatat skor anak panah per rambahan, memantau poin set langsung, menangani status bye/WO, dan memajukan pemenang secara otomatis.
id.content:
Setelah bagan eliminasi dibuat, pertandingan individu maupun beregu dapat dinilai langsung oleh panitia melalui Dashboard Organizer atau dicatat di garis tembak menggunakan aplikasi Archeris Mobile Scorekeeper.

1. Mengakses Daftar Pertandingan Eliminasi

Untuk melihat seluruh jadwal dan pertandingan eliminasi:

  1. Buka menu Dashboard Organizer > Eliminasi > Pertandingan (Matches).
  2. Filter berdasarkan kategori (contoh: Recurve Putra U-15, Compound Putri Open) dan babak pertandingan (contoh: 1/8 Final, Perempat Final, Final Emas).
  3. Klik kartu pertandingan atau simpul pada bagan untuk membuka Modal Penilaian Pertandingan.

2. Input Skor dari Dashboard Panitia

Pada antarmuka desktop dashboard panitia:

  • Sistem Set (Recurve/Barebow): Masukkan nilai anak panah (10, 9, 8, M, dst.) untuk Set 1. Sistem akan menghitung total skor rambahan (contoh: 28 vs 26) dan mengalokasikan Poin Set otomatis (2 - 0). Lanjutkan ke Set 2, 3, dan seterusnya hingga salah satu pemanah mencapai 6 poin set.
  • Sistem Kumulatif (Compound): Masukkan 3 nilai panah per rambahan. Akumulasi total skor akan terus bertambah secara langsung hingga seluruh 5 rambahan (15 anak panah) tuntas.
  • Klik Simpan & Konfirmasi Hasil untuk memfinalisasi pertandingan.

3. Input Skor via Mobile Scorekeeper

Scorekeeper lapangan yang bertugas di bantalan eliminasi dapat menginput skor secara langsung melalui smartphone:

  1. Masuk ke portal scorekeeper menggunakan kode akses sesi yang diberikan panitia.
  2. Pilih nomor bantalan sasaran (contoh: Bantalan 12 - Recurve Putra Perempat Final).
  3. Gunakan keypad dial angka digital untuk menginput nilai anak panah Pemanah A dan Pemanah B.
  4. Konfirmasi total skor rambahan bersama atlet yang bertanding.
  5. Setelah set penentu atau shoot-off selesai, klik kirim skor. Hasil pertandingan langsung terhubung ke bagan publik secara *real-time*.

4. Penanganan Status Bye dan Walkover (WO)

Archeris mendukung pengelolaan otomatis untuk pertandingan non-tanding:

  • Bye Otomatis: Pertandingan yang melibatkan peserta Bye otomatis diselesaikan oleh sistem. Pemanah unggulan langsung melaju ke babak berikutnya tanpa perlu input skor.
  • Walkover / Forfeit (WO): Jika atlet lawan tidak hadir di garis tembak setelah batas panggilan resmi, panitia dapat memilih opsi Tandai Walkover (WO). Pemanah yang hadir otomatis dinyatakan menang dengan skor 6-0 (Sistem Set) atau default kumulatif.
  • Diskualifikasi (DQ): Jika atlet melanggar regulasi alat atau keselamatan, opsi Diskualifikasi (DQ) akan memberikan kemenangan langsung kepada pihak lawan.

5. Kemajuan Otomatis Pohon Bagan (Auto-Advance)

Seketika hasil pertandingan difinalisasi:

  • Pemenang secara instan ditempatkan ke slot babak berikutnya di bagan pohon (contoh: maju dari 1/8 Final ke Perempat Final).
  • Pada babak Semifinal, pemenang otomatis melaju ke Perebutan Medali Emas (*Gold Medal Match*), sementara yang kalah otomatis ditempatkan ke Perebutan Medali Perunggu (*Bronze Medal Match*).
  • Nomor bantalan dan jadwal pertandingan babak berikutnya dapat diatur secara fleksibel melalui panel penjadwalan.
